card.name: Small words inside risk and symptom lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, an, very, like, complete) and the word flu inside lists of symptoms, allergies or risk statements in drug-label text. It looks ahead to a risk-related term.

modes.label: Linking word in a list
modes.description: A small word such as or, an, like or very sits between items in a list of conditions, drugs or risks.

modes.description: The word flu appears in quotes before -like in a list of symptoms.

card.writes: It suppresses words for vulnerable groups such as elderly, pregnant and sensitive, so it steers the next word away from population terms.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in symptom and risk lists, where the next word is a condition rather than a patient group.
